Rover Tracks v2 by nahueltaibo on Thingiverse: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3112734

Summary:
This is the second version of my Rover Tracks design.Many small issues were solved following the recommendations of the people that already built the first version of it. (Thank you guys!)The main idea of this project is to create tracks you can put on any rover you design.As you can see in the video, it is pretty powerful for just having one super cheap motor per track. It was able to tackle every type of terrain I put it on!Check bellow for the list of things you'll need to print and buy and more details on the build.Source code can be downloaded from github here.Here you'll find the design files for the rover tracks:https://a360.co/2P65qvPhttps://a360.co/2vh9BbROne contains the tracks and the other the platform that connects them together.I'd love to see the make!I spent a lot of time designing this. If you like it and want to say thanks by giving me a tip and help me continue to make amazing Things!Good luck!
